tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: The newest US stock market stories, each a short plain-English summary with sentiment (bullish, bearish or neutral), the companies it names and a link. Optionally only stories about one company by ticker (AAPL, NVDA, BRK.B).

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Finds stories whose headline or topic matches a word or phrase (for example "rate cut", "tariffs", "Nvidia earnings"), newest first, each with summary, sentiment and link.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: The full NewsStocks.live write-up of one story: summary, our take, the key numbers, what to watch next, background, and the upside and downside the story names. Pass the url or slug from latest_news or search_news.

tools.name: market_analysis
tools.description: The latest NewsStocks.live market analysis for a day, week or month: overview, what drove the market, the risks, and each sector's outlook, in plain English with a link to the report.
